# Frederick Abalo

[Building software for spatial data and mapping systems.]{.hero-lead}

I'm a geospatial software engineer with experience in spatial-data pipelines, mapping applications, and backend systems. At Zipline, I worked on geospatial systems supporting autonomous delivery. I also own Geomersive, where I work on spatial-data infrastructure.

I'm pursuing a **Master of Urban Spatial Analytics at the University of Pennsylvania**, with expected graduation in **May 2027**. This portfolio brings together my engineering work and academic analyses.

## Selected Projects

::: {.project-grid}
::: {.project-card}
[PERSONAL · ENGINEERING DEMONSTRATION]{.eyebrow}

### Spatial-data validation API

FastAPI and PostGIS service with strict GeoJSON validation, atomic ingestion, spatial queries, and cursor pagination. Tested against a real database and packaged with Docker.

[Read the API case study](projects.qmd#spatial-validation-api)
:::

::: {.project-card}
[PERSONAL · ENGINEERING DEMONSTRATION]{.eyebrow}

### Terrain-aware route explorer

A map and linked elevation profile for comparing illustrative routes against public terrain data, with explicit sampling and accuracy limits.

[Read the terrain case study](projects.qmd#terrain-explorer) · [Try the demo](https://freddie999.github.io/terrain-route-explorer/)
:::

::: {.project-card}
[COURSEWORK · PUBLIC POLICY ANALYTICS]{.eyebrow}

### Poverty change in Philadelphia

An ACS analysis that separates detectable changes from sampling uncertainty and keeps unassessable tracts visible in the results.

[Read the academic case study](projects.qmd#poverty-change) · [Full analysis](assignments/assignment3.qmd)
:::
:::

## Engineering experience

My work spans Python services, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, geospatial ETL, imagery and terrain processing, spatial QA, and production support. I use AWS, Prefect, Docker, and Kubernetes alongside mapping tools and TypeScript/JavaScript interfaces.

Much of my professional code is proprietary. The [Projects page](projects.qmd) distinguishes professional work, independently built demonstrations, and coursework, with public code and evidence where available.
